scope: Local, in-memory demonstration. Nothing is sent to analytics, a registration service or a booking provider. Real results are not collected.

fields.sequence: Increasing sequence within this page; continues after clearing the visible trace.
fields.event: One of the documented sample event names.
fields.occurredAt: ISO timestamp from the local browser clock, not server receipt time.
fields.requestId: Page-local sample-flex-N identifier; not a production customer or booking ID.
fields.source: Always local_simulation; not a service or analytics delivery receipt.
fields.qualification: not_reviewed, met or not_met; explicitly simulated, never inferred.
fields.invalidFields: Only name, email or goal identifiers; never their entered values.
fields.reason: A documented lifecycle reason when a sample qualified state is revoked.

events.sample_path_selected: A visitor explicitly chooses Launch or Scale. This is intent, not a conversion.
events.sample_form_rejected: The form cannot continue. Only invalid field identifiers enter the trace.
events.sample_request_reviewed: Valid sample details reach review. No registration or booking has happened.
events.sample_confirmation_failed: The simulated service rejects confirmation. A retry keeps the same local request ID.
events.sample_registration_confirmed: A new Launch request receives a successful sample confirmation, once per local request.
events.sample_call_request_confirmed: A new Scale request receives a successful sample confirmation with a selected time. It remains unqualified until separately reviewed.
events.sample_qualification_reviewed: An explicit demo review records met, not met or not reviewed. Route choice and time selection never imply qualification.
events.sample_qualified_booking_confirmed: A new confirmed Scale request also has an explicit met qualification review.
events.sample_qualified_booking_revoked: A qualified sample is revised, cancelled or given a different qualification decision.
events.sample_existing_request_recognized: The existing-request scenario returns a previous confirmation. It does not add a new conversion.
events.sample_confirmation_reused: A confirmed request is inspected or reconfirmed. It does not add another registration or call request.
events.sample_request_revision_started: Details are reopened. The current sample confirmation and qualification require review again.
events.sample_request_cancelled: The local request is cancelled. This is separate from a new conversion.
events.sample_availability_notification_request: A page-local notification request is recorded. It is not a booking or a promise of availability.

productionReadiness.requirement: Confirmed service request ID and accepted status. A button click, form review, retry or existing request is not a new registration.
productionReadiness.connection: Not connected in this study. Approved webinar schedule and delivery-service details are not supplied here.

productionReadiness.authority: Booking service plus a separate qualification record
productionReadiness.requirement: An accepted booking and an explicit qualification decision under client-approved criteria. A time selection or Scale route alone is insufficient.
productionReadiness.connection: Not connected. Qualification criteria, review ownership and the production booking service require client approval.

productionReadiness.authority: Attendance record from the approved event/call service
productionReadiness.requirement: Join attendance to the accepted request ID. Report the cohort, period, denominator and missing attendance records.
productionReadiness.connection: No attendance integration or real attendance results.

reporting: Use distinct authoritative service request IDs, a defined acquisition cohort and observation window. Retain cancellations and qualification changes; do not sum repeated confirmation events. Report attendance separately from registration and booking. The local sample IDs cannot prove server deduplication or analytics delivery.
